name: granian

about.summary: A Rust HTTP server for Python applications
A Rust HTTP server for Python applications

raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.8.0"
  summary: A Rust HTTP server for Python applications

recipe:
  name: granian
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/g/granian/granian-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: be842c6737b41beb6fe6521f9c46695a1843ec9e086a18bbbc945ed170ff28e2

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - package:
      name: granian
    build:
      script:
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
          CARGO: cargo-auditable-wrapper${{ ".bat" if win }}
          PYTHONIOENCODING: utf-8
          PYTHONLEGACYTEXTENCODING: utf-8
        content:
          - if: win
            then:
              - copy "%RECIPE_DIR%\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat" "%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat"
            else:
              - cp "${RECIPE_DIR}/cargo-auditable-wrapper.sh" "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
              - chmod 755 "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
          - |-
            ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check
          - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
      python:
        entry_points:
          - granian = granian:cli.cli
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cargo-bundle-licenses
        - cargo-auditable
        - if: unix
          then:
            # for the jemalloc-sys crate
            - make
      host:
        - pip
        - python
        - maturin >=1.14.0,<2
        - if: unix
          then:
            - jemalloc
      run:
        - click >=8.1.0
        - python
      run_constraints:
        - python-dotenv >=1.1,<2
        - rloop >=0.1,<1.0
        - setproctitle >=1.3.3,<1.4
        - uvloop >=0.18.0
        - watchfiles >=1.0,<2.0
        - winloop >=0.2.2
    tests:
      - python:
          imports: granian
          pip_check: true
      - script:
          - granian --help
    about:
      license_file:
        - LICENSE
        - THIRDPARTY.yml

  - package:
      name: granian-with-dotenv
    build:
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("granian", exact=True) }}
        - python-dotenv
    tests:
      - python:
          imports: granian
          pip_check: true
    about:
      summary: ${{ summary }} (with [dotenv])

  - package:
      name: granian-with-pname
    build:
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("granian", exact=True) }}
        - setproctitle
    tests:
      - python:
          imports: granian
          pip_check: true
    about:
      summary: ${{ summary }} (with [pname])

  - package:
      name: granian-with-reload
    build:
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("granian", exact=True) }}
        - watchfiles
    tests:
      - python:
          imports: granian
          pip_check: true
    about:
      summary: ${{ summary }} (with [reload])

  # unix
  - package:
      name: granian-with-rloop
    build:
      noarch: generic
      skip: not unix
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("granian", exact=True) }}
        - rloop
    tests:
      - python:
          imports: granian
          pip_check: true
    about:
      summary: ${{ summary }} (with [rloop])

  - package:
      name: granian-with-uvloop
    build:
      noarch: generic
      skip: not unix
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("granian", exact=True) }}
        - uvloop
    tests:
      - python:
          imports: granian
          pip_check: true
    about:
      summary: ${{ summary }} (with [uvloop])

  # windows
  - package:
      name: granian-with-winloop
    build:
      noarch: generic
      skip: not win
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("granian", exact=True) }}
        - winloop
    tests:
      - python:
          imports: granian
          pip_check: true
    about:
      license_file: LICENSE
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      summary: ${{ summary }} (with [winloop])

  - package:
      name: granian-with-all
    build:
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("granian", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("granian-with-pname", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("granian-with-reload", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("granian-with-dotenv", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports: granian
          pip_check: true
    about:
      license_file: LICENSE
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      summary: ${{ summary }} (with all platform-independent [extras])

about:
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/granian
  summary: ${{ summary }}
  repository: https://github.com/emmett-framework/granian
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  feedstock-name: granian
  recipe-maintainers:
    - thewchan
    - bollwyvl
